title: Moonlit Lasagna
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic, add passata, simmer 20 minutes.
Make a béchamel from butter, flour and milk.
Layer sheets, meat sauce, ricotta and béchamel; top with mozzarella.

title: Juniper Hill Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Beat in eggs, milk and butter until just smooth.
Fry ladlefuls in a hot pan until golden on both sides.

title: Saffron Lane Pad Thai
steps: Stir-fry shrimp, push aside, scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, fish sauce, tamarind and sugar; toss for 2 minutes.
Finish with peanuts, sprouts and spring onions.
